verses: Then I saw the soul of a woman, through whose body a grievous prickly? snake ascended, and came forth by the mouth.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, where the soul suffers so severe a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who violated a next-of-kin khwetodas marriage.'
